events.title: 6th Annual Fall Foliage Ride
events.description:
I know it's waaaay early to think about the Fall Foliage Ride, but I wanted to remind everyone who's coming of the importance of early accommodations. If you're even thinking of coming, you should book lodging now. This is peak tourism season in the area and cabins book-up a year in advance. Plus there are always other, bigger events at TWoS on that same weekend, so plan ahead.
**Update**
All the cabins and rooms at TWoS are rented. You'll have to find accommodations elsewhere. Contact TWoS here: https://twowheelsofsuches.com/
There are also multiple Airbnb rentals available and some wineries/resorts in the area that offer accommodations. Here are some cabins just up the road from TWoS: https://www.kennedycreekresort.com/ There is also camping at TWoS & other more remote sites in the area.
